notes: 2026-10-18: Local collision-constrained steering now bypasses peers and finite obstacles for humans and animals. Genuine model retraining, 48 heldout MLP blocked-production episodes, 138 tests, native movement/hunting/restart and primary-save continuation verified. Runtime history archived durably to control nine-person checkpoint growth. See blocked-steering-repair.md. User acceptance remains pending.

2026-10-18: Six-species animal shared-trunk life/combat MLP genuinely trained and active in formal Unity; original HUD retained. Complete reset fixed and applied to primary save with private backup; fresh paused tick0 verified after reopening. 172 gameplay/reset tests, 10 launch/package tests, native hunting/reset/restart and channel cache regression passed. User acceptance pending.
P0 and P1 accepted by user.
P2 implemented; acceptance consolidated with P3-P6 by user instruction 2026-10-17.
Verified Unity default launch now opens village-v1 with both genuine v4 models; named balance supplements remain experiment rules.
User authorized continuous P3-P6 implementation and one unified final acceptance.

stages.exitCriteria: 原件保留，D/SD 方案登记，基线和新时钟可追溯；不重置旧世界。
人物/知识/目标/命令/计划协议统一；候选特征和同源模拟可测试。
真实 Life alpha；真实模型提议与分别同意；至少一种装备或休整约定实际兑现。
真实 Tactical alpha；两条围栏/长弓分支运行至战后，后续合作读取经历。
完整玩法与社会机制贯通；制度有实际效果；评测夹具在正式训练前冻结。
真实权重、同规则对照、反事实、多日与模型离线报告，失败项明确。
旧档不丢、新社会状态可恢复、版本一致、桌面端可操作、发布可回滚。
